title: Auto-lock utility-knife task suite
goal: Verify the working detent, loaded holding behavior, second detent, and complete blade retraction of an auto-lock utility knife.

profiles.title: Forty-five-millimetre auto-lock knife
profiles.description: The approved legacy profile with 45 mm and 25 mm detents and a 30 N reverse-load check.

scenarios.title: Extend to the working detent
execution_requirements: Actuate only the authored thumb input and detent mechanism.
Measure blade-carriage displacement from its frozen prismatic home position.

scenarios.title: Hold the working detent under reverse load
execution_requirements: Reach and latch the working detent before applying the reverse load.
Apply a fixed 30 N reverse axial load for 0.3 s without following or repositioning the blade.
Record maximum blade slip during the complete holding interval.

scenarios.title: Select the second detent
execution_requirements: Use the physical detent path to reach the second position; do not set the blade pose directly.
Evaluate the final latched blade-carriage position.

scenarios.title: Complete extension and retraction cycle
execution_requirements: Complete extension and retraction through the authored latch and detent motions.
Use final home position as the pass authority; cumulative travel is supporting evidence only.

tasks.title: Extend the blade to the working position
tasks.goal: Latch the blade carriage at the 45 mm working detent.

criteria.description: The blade carriage finishes at 0.045 m from home within 0.0015 m.

failure_diagnostics.description: The blade did not finish within the approved working-position range.
The carriage reached the region but did not remain physically latched.

evidence_obligations: Report final signed blade displacement from the frozen home frame.
Preserve latch-contact evidence together with the physical and ideal-reference traces.

tasks.title: Hold the working position under reverse load
tasks.goal: Keep the blade latched at the working position while a fixed reverse axial load is applied.

criteria.description: The test applies the approved 30 N reverse axial load.
The complete 30 N load is held for at least 0.3 s.
Blade-carriage slip during the loaded hold does not exceed 0.0015 m.
After the hold, the blade remains at 0.045 m from home within 0.0015 m.

failure_diagnostics.description: The applied reverse load magnitude or duration did not match the approved profile.
The blade moved farther than the allowed slip while loaded.
The blade no longer occupied the accepted working-position range after the hold.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the fixed-direction 30 N actuation trace for the full 0.3 s interval.
Report both maximum loaded slip and final blade displacement.

tasks.title: Select the second blade position
tasks.goal: Latch the blade carriage at the 25 mm second detent.

criteria.description: The blade carriage finishes at 0.025 m from home within 0.0015 m.

failure_diagnostics.description: The blade did not finish within the approved second-position range.
The carriage reached the region but did not remain physically latched.

evidence_obligations: Report final signed blade displacement and the second-detent contact state.

tasks.title: Retract the blade completely
tasks.goal: Return the blade carriage to the home position after an extension cycle.

criteria.description: The final blade-carriage position is 0 m from home within 0.0015 m.
The cycle accumulates at least 0.09 m of blade travel; this is supporting evidence and cannot replace the final home-position check.

failure_diagnostics.description: The blade did not return within the approved home-position tolerance.
The supporting cumulative-travel result was below 0.09 m.

evidence_obligations: Report final home-position error independently from cumulative travel.
Preserve the full physical extension-and-retraction trace.

source_projects.note: The source project supplied certified detent task evidence. The 30 N load remains specific to this approved profile rather than a universal utility-knife constant.

approval.basis: The user approved the reviewed utility-knife task package with explicit position, load, hold-duration, slip, and retraction tolerances.
